analysis: Step 2 benign versus borderline-or-malignant lesion triage
author_confirmed_timing: Model specification was finalised using the development cohort before evaluation in the temporally separated cohort.
development_resampling: 20 repeats of stratified five-fold out-of-fold prediction
temporal_validation_probability: mean probability from 100 fixed development-fold models
threshold_rule: Correctly classify at least one additional BD+M participant and one additional benign participant relative to CA125 at 35 U/mL; then use accuracy, F1, specificity and the higher threshold as deterministic tie-breakers.
